values.note: 22 single/double sites in three loops (Golden Eagle 001-005 and Bald Eagle 017-022 electric; Osprey 006-011 and Red Tailed Hawk 012-016 non-electric) plus the Great Horned Owl group site; 12 reservable, 10 first-come. All back-in, gravel; catalog lengths 30-50 ft (Red Tailed Hawk 30). Equipment must fit the spur; no overflow parking.

note: USFS campground on a peninsula above McPhee Reservoir near Dolores, in a gently sloping, unshaded grassy meadow near the high-water line. The west-edge sites (Osprey 008-009, Bald Eagle 019-020) sit at the top of a willow/cottonwood bank ~50 m from the shore; the reservoir draws down well below the campground. Paved access road and parking; four-lane boat ramp on site. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 22 sites (12 reservable), 50-amp on bookable sites, vault/composting toilets, potable water, season May-Sept. Fees 32/65 -> 32/43 (FS $32 + $11 electric; the $65 is the double-site and two odd single-site templates, in fees.note). Added max length 50, no pull-throughs, water hookup false, dump false (closed since 6/2025), max stay 28, booking.season 05-08..09-26. Note trimmed.
flags: Missing phone: Dolores Ranger District (970) 882-7296 (FS page, 'Office Contact Information'). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line (661) 702-1420 (contact @goexplorus.com).
Operator: concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact goexplorus.com). Ownership federal stands.

Fees: recreation.gov's 2026 Peak table assigns the 'PeakSTANDARD ELECTRIC' template ($65) to single sites 020 and 021, while the FS says an electric site is $32 + $11 and the other single electric sites use the $43 template. Recorded $43 as the high; a human may want to check 020/021 on the booking page.

Waterfront (stored lakeview) stands: rec.gov says 'located on the shores of McPhee Reservoir' / FS 'near the reservoir's high-water line'. On imagery the nearest sites (008, 009, 019, 020) sit at the top of a bank ~40-70 m from the bare drawdown band, behind a dense willow/cottonwood belt - screened, not an open apron. The rest are farther inland.

Pin 37.51561,-108.53548 is the FS page's coordinate, at the group site/picnic area at the south end of the complex; the 12 catalogued site points' centroid is 473 m NW (the farthest loop, Bald Eagle, ~650 m). Under the ~500 m threshold but the pin is not on the campsite loops; a human may prefer ~37.5187,-108.5392.

Status: FS page shows 'Site Closed' - ordinary end of season. Dolores RD road status lists FR 528 (House Creek, lower) Open, seasonal 5/1-12/1; the Oct 23 2026 San Juan flooding alert names no Dolores RD closure on this road.
